cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(TaskflowLiteConsumer LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()

option(TFL_CONSUMER_SUBPROJECT "Test add_subdirectory instead of find_package" OFF)
if(TFL_CONSUMER_SUBPROJECT)
    get_filename_component(_tfl_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
    add_subdirectory("${_tfl_source}" taskflowlite)
else()
    find_package(TaskflowLite CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()

add_executable(test_consumer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_consumer PRIVATE TaskflowLite::taskflowlite)
add_test(NAME consumer COMMAND test_consumer)
set_tests_properties(consumer PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
